assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances in an outpatient setting
The diagnosis code I25.10 is cited for atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The diagnosis code I47.1 is cited for the arrhythmia
Mobile cardiac telemetry is associated with CPT code 93229
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
SilverBridge Advantage requires all such diagnostic monitoring services to be pre-approved
The service was rendered to diagnose a documented arrhythmia in the presence of established coronary artery disease
The service satisfies the medical necessity standard cited in the payer's own requirement for pre-approval of such diagnostic monitoring services
